critical_findings.finding: SkillCatalog Tool Implementation vs Documentation Mismatch
evidence: skill-catalog.cjs EXISTS and appears functional (100 lines of query logic)
skill-index.json EXISTS (8,621 lines, 434 skills indexed, generated 2026-02-04)
BUT: SkillCatalog is a MODULE not a CLAUDE CODE TOOL
CLAUDE.md Section 1.4 lists 'SkillCatalog' as one of 24 core tools
Tool invocation: SkillCatalog({ domain: 'testing' }) would FAIL (not a host tool)
Actual usage: require() in code, not callable via Tool interface
critical_findings.impact: Agents may attempt SkillCatalog() and fail. Documentation claims it's a tool but it's a library.
critical_findings.root_cause: Confusion between 'tool' (Claude Code host-provided) and 'module' (Node.js require())
critical_findings.recommended_fix: Clarify in @TOOL_REFERENCE.md that SkillCatalog is library-only, or implement as actual tool

gaps_identified.description: CLAUDE.md lists SkillCatalog as a 'core tool' but it's actually a Node.js module (require-only), not a Claude Code host tool
